customManagers.description: Image tags pinned via a `# renovate:` annotation, where the chart supplies the repository and only the tag is overridden

packageRules.description: The in-cluster registry is only reachable from the cluster, so Renovate can neither authenticate nor list tags there. gymbros tags are bumped by CI on every commit anyway.
argocd Applications track this same repo at HEAD; there is no version to bump
Default: Do not automerge Helm charts
Trust list: Automerge these specific Helm charts
Docker: Automerge minor and patch updates
Nextcloud only supports upgrading one major at a time, so majors are reviewed by hand and never grouped away
Immich majors have carried breaking database migrations (v3.0.0 dropped pgvecto.rs); review by hand

A Postgres major is a data migration (pg_upgrade or dump/restore), not an image swap - swapping the tag leaves the new binary pointed at an old data directory and the pod will not start. Immich's own reference compose pins the 14 line.
